PLAN "Integrated 12-Week Return-to-Ski: Strength, Nutrition, Cardio, and Recovery (Low-Impact)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build knee-friendly strength and prepare for skiing; maintain weight; peak readiness by Week 12"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Foundational strength & knee safety":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
          hamstring_stretch 60s
      CARDIO OPTION:
        modality running 20m 2x/wk (keep low impact)
      REcovery/Mobility: include foam roll post-session; light knee mobility
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progression & knee safety":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_raise 60s
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
      CARDIO:
        modality walking 20m 2x/wk
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Stability & control":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_deadlift 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_extension 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_adduction_stretch 60s
          child_pose 60s
      CARDIO:
        modality cycling 15m 2x/wk
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Deload & technique":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 60s
      RECOVERY/MOBILITY:
        mobility sequence: couch stretch, hip circles, thoracic mobility
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Strength progression w/knee-friendly loads":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
          hamstring_stretch 60s
      CARDIO:
        modality running 25m 2x/wk
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Volume build with control":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..7 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_raise 60s
      CARDIO:
        modality cycling 20m 2x/wk
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Pattern work & knee-friendly capacity":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          sumo_squat 3x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 60s
      CARDIO:
        modality rowing 15m 2x/wk
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Deload & technique refinement":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 60s
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Peak strength foundation for ski return":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60s
      CARDIO:
        modality cycling 25m 2x/wk
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Loading progression w/respect to knee":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 4x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chest_fly 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 60s
      CARDIO:
        modality running 20m 2x/wk
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Sport-specific strength & control":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_external_rotations 60s
      CARDIO:
        modality cycling 20m 2x/wk
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Taper to ski readiness & peak feeling":
        warmup:
          cycling 5m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body stretching 120s
  NUTRITION PHASES (integrated with above)
    Phase 1-3: same structure as prior nutrition plan; add occasional higher-protein post-workout snacks; adjust calories to maintenance baseline with minor tweaks for training days.

CARDIO PLAN (integrated)
  - Week 1-4: low-impact cardio 2x/wk; options: cycling, walking, or rowing; keep sessions light to moderate to protect knee.
  - Week 5-8: progressive cardio variety up to 2x/wk; introduce longer or slightly higher intensity sessions as tolerated, always knee-friendly.
  - Week 9-12: maintain 2x/wk; emphasize conditioning and ski-specific readiness; include light tempo or steady-state days around lifting.

RECOVERY & MOBILITY (integrated)
  - Phase 1: mobility & soft tissue work 2x/wk; knee-friendly ranges; diaphragmatic breathing.
  - Phase 2: add stability drills; partial ROM strength; balance progressions.
  - Phase 3: movement quality, stability, and prep for skiing; functional readiness tests weekly (ROM, pain, confidence).
  - Recovery checks: pain log, swelling tracking, ROM weekly; adjust plan if pain worsens.

NUTRITION & PEAK WEEK
  - Protein: 1.6–1.8 g/kg/day; distribute across meals; add 20–40 g post-workout as needed.
  - Carbs: align with training; higher around strength sessions; maintain overall maintenance calories with slight up-ticks on heavier days for Week 9–12.
  - Fats: fill rest of calories with healthy fats.
  - Hydration: baseline 2.5–3.0 L/day; increase on training days.
  - Peak Week (Week 12): slight bump in protein; slight carb around workouts; taper training volume while preserving intensity; ensure sleep 7–9 hours.

TRACKING & ADJUSTMENTS
  - Weekly weigh-ins; target maintenance +/- 1–2 kg.
  - Performance markers: monitor lifts for progression; if stall, adjust set/rep ranges or load.
  - Knee comfort: daily log; adjust program if swelling or pain increases.
  - Sleep and stress: aim 7–9 hours; include relaxation strategies.

CONTRAINDICATIONS AND SAFETY
  - No jumping; avoid deep knee flexion under load; knee-friendly loading only.
  - If pain/swelling worsens, consult clinician and modify plan accordingly.

        guidance:

        macro_targets:
          calories maintenance estimate 2650
        protein_target 1.8 g/kg
        fat_target 0.9 g/kg
        carb_target remaining calories
        guidance:
          - Pre-workout: 20–40 g carbs + 15–25 g protein 1–2 hours before.

      DAY Monday nutrition 0m "Ski-specific energy readiness":
        macro_targets:
          calories maintenance estimate 2650
        protein_target 1.6 g/kg
        fat_target 0.9 g/kg
        carb_target remaining calories
        guidance:
          - Include moderate glycemic index carbs around training times.
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday nutrition 0m "Taper and sustain":
        macro_targets:
          calories maintenance estimate 2600
        protein_target 1.8 g/kg
        fat_target 0.9 g/kg
        carb_target remaining calories
        guidance:
          - Maintain consistency; prepare for ski season demands.

NUTRITION GUIDELINES
  - Protein: aim 1.6–1.8 g/kg bodyweight per day; distribute evenly across 3–4 meals, plus 1–2 post-workout snacks if training on that day.
  - Carbohydrates: amount tailored to energy needs; prioritize complex carbohydrates (oats, quinoa, rice, whole grains, fruits, vegetables) around training.
  - Fats: healthy fats (olive oil, avocado, nuts, fatty fish) to meet remaining calories after protein and carbs are allocated.
  - Fiber: 25–38 g/day; hydrate adequately to support digestion.
  - Hydration: baseline 2.5–3.0 L/day; add fluids around training; adjust for sweat and climate.
  - micronutrients: ensure adequate calcium, vitamin D, iron, magnesium; consider a multivitamin if dietary gaps exist.

MEAL PATTERN SUGGESTIONS
  - Breakfast: protein source + complex carb + fruit
  - Lunch: lean protein + vegetables + whole grain
  - Dinner: lean protein + vegetables + starch
  - Snacks: yogurt, cottage cheese, protein shake, nuts, fruit
  - Pre-workout option: oats with milk/yogurt and berries
  - Post-workout option: whey or plant-based protein + banana

TRACKING AND ADJUSTMENT
  - Weekly weigh-ins on same day/time; target maintenance within +/- 1–2 kg range.
  - If weight drifts >2 kg over 2 weeks, adjust calories by ~150–200 kcal/day.
  - Use food log to monitor protein intake and meal timing.
  - Monitor knee comfort; adjust carbohydrate timing to support training days if needed.
  - Prioritize sleep (7–9 hours) to support recovery and adaptation.

CONTRAINDICATIONS AND SAFETY
  - No considerations required beyond standard: maintain adequate protein intake to support tissue repair; avoid crash dieting.
  - If knee symptoms worsen, adjust training plan and nutrition accordingly with clinician guidance.

  - All mobility and recovery work must remain knee-friendly: no deep knee flexion under load; avoid jumping or high-impact movements.

  - ROM progress: measure knee flexion/extension weekly.
  - If ROM improvement stalls for >2 weeks, adjust mobility sequence or consult clinician.

    Phase 1-3: same structure as prior nutrition plan; add occasional higher-protein post-workout snacks; adjust calories to maintenance baseline with minor tweaks for training days.

CARDIO PLAN (integrated)
  - Week 1-4: low-impact cardio 2x/wk; options: cycling, walking, or rowing; keep sessions light to moderate to protect knee.
  - Week 5-8: progressive cardio variety up to 2x/wk; introduce longer or slightly higher intensity sessions as tolerated, always knee-friendly.
  - Week 9-12: maintain 2x/wk; emphasize conditioning and ski-specific readiness; include light tempo or steady-state days around lifting.

RECOVERY & MOBILITY (integrated)
  - Phase 1: mobility & soft tissue work 2x/wk; knee-friendly ranges; diaphragmatic breathing.
  - Phase 2: add stability drills; partial ROM strength; balance progressions.
  - Phase 3: movement quality, stability, and prep for skiing; functional readiness tests weekly (ROM, pain, confidence).
  - Recovery checks: pain log, swelling tracking, ROM weekly; adjust plan if pain worsens.

NUTRITION & PEAK WEEK
  - Protein: 1.6–1.8 g/kg/day; distribute across meals; add 20–40 g post-workout as needed.
  - Carbs: align with training; higher around strength sessions; maintain overall maintenance calories with slight up-ticks on heavier days for Week 9–12.
  - Fats: fill rest of calories with healthy fats.
  - Hydration: baseline 2.5–3.0 L/day; increase on training days.
  - Peak Week (Week 12): slight bump in protein; slight carb around workouts; taper training volume while preserving intensity; ensure sleep 7–9 hours.

TRACKING & ADJUSTMENTS
  - Weekly weigh-ins; target maintenance +/- 1–2 kg.
  - Performance markers: monitor lifts for progression; if stall, adjust set/rep ranges or load.
  - Knee comfort: daily log; adjust program if swelling or pain increases.
  - Sleep and stress: aim 7–9 hours; include relaxation strategies.

CONTRAINDICATIONS AND SAFETY
  - No jumping; avoid deep knee flexion under load; knee-friendly loading only.
  - If pain/swelling worsens, consult clinician and modify plan accordingly.
